provider: FakeWorkerProvider; no E2B VM, volume or credential

lanes.scenario: A historical run request without the new fields keeps its behavior

evidence.test: worker plan keeps every run in process without a query when no worker provider is composed
provider-neutral computer workspace restores a checkpoint into a replacement provider machine
provider-neutral computer workspace checkpoints a Docker computer on the local store by revision, without copying

evidence.detail: 162 tests in 23 suites: the 159 baseline tests unchanged plus 3 new Postgres race tests

lanes.scenario: Two concurrent attempts of one run
lanes.pass_when: Only one active attempt holds the fence

evidence.test: starts a worker only for the attempt holding the run's fence; lets one of two runs racing for the same volumes write, whatever their grant order; lets one of two concurrent starts of the same attempt reach the provider
evidence.database: PostgreSQL 16 in Testcontainers via pnpm test:integration

evidence.test: worker start refuses an attempt that no longer holds the run's fence before the provider
worker ownership while start is in flight refuses a second start of the same attempt before the provider
worker release reports a worker inactive once a newer claim takes the run's fence
worker schema rejects a row that breaks attempts_runId_live_worker_key
worker schema rejects a row that breaks attempts_runId_fence_key

lanes.scenario: Refuse a private volume that belongs to another bot
lanes.pass_when: The request fails before any provider call

evidence.test: worker start refuses private_volume_of_other_bot before the provider
worker plan refuses a run whose migrated home lacks its private volume

lanes.scenario: Refuse a shared volume that belongs to another space
lanes.pass_when: The request fails before any provider call

evidence.test: worker start refuses shared_volume_of_other_space before the provider
worker plan refuses a run whose migrated home lacks its shared volume

lanes.scenario: An MCP-only run without a computer
lanes.pass_when: No computer lease and no user mount are required

evidence.test: worker start gives an MCP-only run a worker without a computer, mount or lease

lanes.scenario: Reconcile a provisioning interrupted after the provider reference was assigned
lanes.pass_when: The provider reference finds and cleans the resource

evidence.test: worker release reconciles workers whose run lease expired, by ref or by attempt tag
worker ownership while start is in flight holds the leases of a run cancelled mid-ensure until its late VM is destroyed
worker ownership while start is in flight records the VM of an ensure that outlived its timeout until a destroy succeeds
worker start releases the worker and its volumes when setup fails

lanes.scenario: Delete a worker already absent at the provider
lanes.pass_when: The second deletion succeeds without side effect

evidence.test: worker release destroys once however often it is released, and an absent VM is released too
worker ownership while start is in flight keeps the lease of a worker the provider cannot confirm destroyed
worker release reaches a healthy worker behind one whose destroy fails, one worker per pass

lanes.scenario: Keep volumes after the run closes
lanes.pass_when: References and persistent rows stay present

evidence.test: worker release keeps volume rows and provider refs after the run ends
worker schema deletes a space without volumes, and refuses one that still owns a volume

lanes.scenario: Other adapters with the shared contracts
lanes.pass_when: Non-E2B configurations compile and degrade explicitly

evidence.test: volume provisioning and home adoption never adopts a home on a computer kind without workers
worker schema rejects a row that breaks computers_home_storage_check
worker plan keeps every run in process without a query when no worker provider is composed

lanes.scenario: Apply the migration to a test database that holds old sessions

evidence.test: worker and volume migrations leave existing sessions, runs, attempts and homes as they were

limits: These lanes prove the controller contract against a fake provider. They do not prove storage isolation, which belongs to I1.
